subject.description: Unverified reused candidate report (sections U001-U012, schema er7.candidate_report_seed.v1, source_job_id t02-m-ome-dev1-control-r1).

method: Full independent read of every admitted artifact: inputs/sources/S003.txt (all 896 lines in three ranges), inputs/plan/Viewer.md (11 lines), inputs/brief.md (5 lines), TASK.md, and the complete seed. Every normative claim and line citation in each seed section was checked against the fresh source read; Viewer.md and brief line cites were checked against those files. The seed was treated as a claim set, never as an answer key.

section_results.notes: Header facts verified: S003 is 896 lines (tool-reported total), source URL https://ngff.openmicroscopy.org/0.5/ at S003 L5-L10, brief and plan descriptions match. The seed's 'two assignment groups' coverage claim is its own organization of brief L3's capability list; no separate assignment file exists in inputs/ (probes FileNotFoundError; recorded as coverage limit in acquisition record, not an absence claim). Citation convention and status vocabulary are internally consistent with the source.

All executive-summary citations verified: Zarr v3 + zarr.json (L68-72, L87-100), ome namespace + hierarchy-consistent version 0.5 (L150-165), typed key inventory matches sections 2.1-2.8 + 2.2, unbounded Zarr features (L70-72, no disallowance anywhere in the 896-line read), Tools pointer (L813-814), UNEXECUTED validation framing.

All six governing conditions and their cites verified verbatim or near-verbatim: L68-69, L70-72, L73-77, L150-155, L156, L157-165, L57-59, L872-876, L60-64, L877-878, L879-888, L65-66, L25-27, L810-812, and the literal-key list (field_count L538/L595, rowIndex/columnIndex L557-560, label-value L462, starttime/endtime L528, maximumfieldcount L524, bioformats2raw.layout L200). Editorial duplicate 'by the by the' confirmed across L93-94.

Group 1 fully verified: group/array structure (L87-100); three fileset shapes (L82-100, L118-148, L175-275); plate precedence (L204-206, L262-263); multi-multiscales rule + pseudocode (L388-397); wells enumeration and index/path identity (L552-560); well.images + acquisition trigger (L744-750); full row/column enumeration (L532-533, L544-545); sparse example (L641-739); empty row/well SHOULD NOT (L128-129); layout MUST equal 3 (L193-203, L256); series rules (L243-253, L264-267); numbered fallback (L268-270); one-Image-per-group (L270); METADATA.ome.xml SHOULD/MUST/MAY (L257-260); reader multiplicity SHOULD (L272), MAYs (L273-275); labels-not-images (L437-438); field enumeration examples (L763-780, L795-803); acquisition ids (L520-522); acquisition fields (L523-529); field_count/name (L538-541); axes/datasets MUSTs (L299-308); largest-to-smallest order (L305-306); arbitrary names (L93-94); shared dimensionality (L307); axes length (L173); dimension_names (L174); name/type/metadata SHOULDs (L317-319); gaussian example (L375-382); layout sketches (L91-94, L116-117); name constraints (L533-537, L546-549, L746-748).

Group 2 citations all verified: axes rank/order/typing (L96-97, L168-174, L299-303); axis names arbitrary (L81); unit lists (L170-172); dimension_names conflict L174 vs L827 confirmed verbatim; omero MUSTs (L426-430) and example fields (L401-423) including 'Array matching the c dimension size' comment at L403; transform vocabulary and sequential application (L279-293); per-level exactly-one-scale / translation-after-scale / vector lengths (L309-312); global transforms applied after (L314-316) with time-scale example (L368-374); worked example values (L320-387) re-computed correctly (level 0: dt 0.1 ms, dxyz 0.5 um); labels discovery/listing (L102-108, L441-453), intermediate folders metadata-free (L110, L439-440), arbitrary names (L112, L440), integer dtypes (L438-439, L116-117), level-count parity (L454-455), alignment 'usually' (L432-433), image-label keys (L456-474), colors/display SHOULD (L461-466), rgba example 50% blue/green (L476-514). QUALIFICATION C2: the seed frames applying omero window/color as MUST-level viewer obligations; the source MUSTs bind conforming file content, and reader-side use is a motivated product implementation of transitional read support (L60-64). Applied in report R5.2/R6.1.

Obligation/Recommendation/Option/product-decision split verified against the source; every listed line cite checked. QUALIFICATION C3: the final SHOULD-list item ('camelCase for keys the viewer writes to its own session store') extends S003 L810-812, which governs the specification's own keys; reclassified in report R6.2 as a product convention inspired by the source, not a source-backed recommendation.

Every Viewer.md line cite verified against the plan: L5 (open/list, canvas pan/zoom, channel/time/plane controls, overlays, details panel, pyramid-level choice), L7 (background reads, cancellation, failure explanations), L9 (real-tool interoperability, unchanged sources, session-local settings, exclusions, explicit review), L11 (acceptance criteria incl. no-freeze and malformed-input feedback). Brief L3/L5 cites verified. The KEEP/EXTEND/FLAG dispositions are judgment calls consistent with the verified source obligations.

All unsupported-input classes and their cites verified: unbounded Zarr features (L70-72), binary path transforms (L285-289), version/namespace/rank/axis/path/transform violations (L156, L173-174, L299-312), well/acquisition violations (L553-560, L748-750), non-3 layout (L256), label violations (L438-455), malformed omero (L426-430), product-boundary exclusions (brief L5, Viewer.md L9), release status (L25-27), OME-XML MetadataOnly (L257-260).

Items 1-2 and 4-13 verified as stated (dimension_names conflict; null axis type tension L301 vs L169; scale-1.0 ambiguity L310; translation origin L311; composition L315; multi-multiscales force L388-397; omero channel-length comment L403; label 'usually' L433 + broadcast L106-108; version vocabularies L459-460/L550-551/L751-752; layout==3 unexplained L200/L256; acquisition trigger ambiguity L748-749; binary path L285-289; field_count vs maximumfieldcount L538-539/L524-525; whole-format risk L70-72, L813-814). QUALIFICATION C1 on item 3: the seed says the largest-to-smallest metric is undefined, but S003 L306 itself glosses 'largest (i.e. highest resolution)'; the residual ambiguity is in defining 'resolution', not total absence of a metric. Applied in report R4.4/R9.3.

Reader-evidence gap verified: section 4 'Implementations' is exactly 'See Tools.' (L813-814); section 5 Citing (L815-820) carries no implementation requirements; no reader-tolerance/performance/error-handling behavior appears anywhere in the 896-line read. Correctly labeled a scope limitation, not an incompatibility finding.
All nine validation proposals are labeled UNEXECUTED in the seed; no seed claim asserts execution. Proposals map onto verified findings; carried into report R13 with the same UNEXECUTED labels.
Source-line index spot-checked exhaustively against the full read; every locator range resolves to the claimed content (including conformance L868-888, history L822-866, release status L25-27).

corrections_applied_to_fresh_report.issue: 'Largest->smallest metric undefined (S003 L306)' overstates: source glosses 'largest (i.e. highest resolution)'.
corrections_applied_to_fresh_report.resolution: Report R4.4/R9.3 state the source gloss, keep the residual 'resolution' ambiguity, and keep the voxel-count sanity check without reordering.

corrections_applied_to_fresh_report.issue: Applying omero window/color framed as MUST-level viewer obligations; source MUSTs (L426-430) bind file content, and section 2.5 is transitional (L60-64).
corrections_applied_to_fresh_report.resolution: Report R5.2/R6.1 label reader-side use a strongly motivated product implementation of transitional read support, not a source-imposed rendering MUST.

corrections_applied_to_fresh_report.issue: camelCase for viewer session-store keys cited as a source-backed SHOULD; S003 L810-812 governs the specification's own keys.
corrections_applied_to_fresh_report.resolution: Reclassified in report R3 item 6 / R6.2 as a product convention inspired by the source.

corrections_applied_to_fresh_report.issue: 'Both assignment groups' framing presented as the assignment's structure; no separate assignment artifact exists in inputs/. Also adds the L875-876 keyword-case caveat the seed did not surface, which strengthens the reading of lowercase imperatives (L96, L300, L388-397).
corrections_applied_to_fresh_report.resolution: Report R2/R11 record the probes as coverage limits (no absence claim); report R3 preamble adopts the L875-876 caveat; report R9 item 6 notes its effect.

rejected_material_note: No seed finding was rejected as unsupported. All four corrections are qualifications of strength or framing; the seed's factual citations all verified against the full source read.
conclusion: The seed is substantively accurate and well-cited: 10 of 12 sections fully supported, 2 supported with qualifications (C1-C3 plus framing C4). The fresh standalone report out/reports/V001.md preserves all supported material, applies the qualifications, and independently reproduces the analysis with complete S003 line evidence.
